ssot_rule: Until a stream status is 'cutover', timerloggedout-spec/termux-monorepo is the source of truth and this repo is a mirror.

stays_in_monorepo.reason: state, not a log; gates consume it in place; entries lane single-writer
consumer-bound; live dashboard reads in place
authored knowledge / definitions, context-bound to the code

streams.consumer: Provenance attribution + HindSight retain sink (separate systems)
streams.kind: append-only telemetry envelopes / retain payloads (ids, counts, hashes only)
streams.sensitivity: public-safe by contract (secret-shape guard in ingest)
streams.writer: scripts/telemetry_ingest/ingest.py via telemetry-ingest workflow (built 2026-10-28, not landed on master)

streams.consumer: certifications evidence index in termux-monorepo (guides/certifications-* + issue #506)
streams.kind: raw evidence artifacts (execution receipts, notebooks, completion pages)
streams.sensitivity: public (cert index data only; no account credentials)
streams.writer: certifications lane + owning challenge lanes, via PR
